title: Yellow Armored Boy Poses
description: Four sequential views of a young male character with spiky blond hair wearing a bulky yellow and black armored suit with mechanical details. The panels show him standing ready, running forward with motion blur, punching with a bright yellow energy explosion effect from his fist, and returning to a neutral standing pose.
prompt: A four-panel sequence of a fierce young boy with spiky blond hair and an angry expression, wearing a bulky yellow and black mechanical armored suit with glowing details. First panel standing ready pose, second panel running forward with motion lines, third panel powerful punch with bright yellow energy explosion and sparks bursting from his fist, fourth panel standing neutral. Dramatic lighting, painted digital art style on dark gradient background.
